results.title: Who is Brittney Griner’s estranged wife Cherelle? All about the couple as Connecticut Sun star files for divorce
results.description: Brittney Griner has filed for divorce from her wife, Cherelle Griner, after eight years of marriage, marking the end of a relationship that endured extraordinary public challenges. The feature explores Cherelle's legal career, how the couple met at Baylor University, their marriage and son Bash, and Cherelle's pivotal role in securing Griner's release from a Russian prison before their eventual separation.
